Callout.Name: Illegal Trapping
Callout.Message: Traps found set along a trail.
Callout.Advisory: No persons present, several traps armed.

Script.Line: They are set every ten yards along the fence line.
One of them has something in it and it is still moving.
I have not touched them. I am not touching them.

Lines.Approach: Six of them set along the trail and one has something in it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
